labels: The rear classmate's two arms curve around the front classmate's midsection, with both hands visible over the front of the outer cardigan and each body outline distinct.; 뒤 동급생의 두 팔이 앞 동급생의 몸통을 감싸고 두 손은 겉 가디건 앞면 위에 보이며 두 사람의 몸 윤곽이 구분된다.
definition: Complete optional school-life visual realization: The rear classmate's two arms curve around the front classmate's midsection, with both hands visible over the front of the outer cardigan and each body outline distinct.
